data.body: Close refused (no force used): the 3311 workflow step's '# mechanism-ok:' marker named this ticket as its sunset ticket, and src/rebar/_commands/sunset_markers.py refuses to close a ticket whose marker is still in the tree. Follow-up change 3321 removes the mechanism rather than repointing it: the jobs fetch moves into the existing, baselined normalize step (fetched only when the aggregate is failure with nothing observed failed; a failed fetch keeps the fail-closed failure). Mechanism census 647 -> 646 active, make lint exit 0, make typecheck clean, 1544 related tests pass. New tests run the step's own shell with a stub gh: failed fetch -> failure, captured not-acquired payload -> cancelled, success -> no fetch.
